task: TA30-34 actual dialog content ratio narrow source review

finding.cause: The page universal selector sets box-sizing:border-box. The modal canvas has width:100%, 1px border on both axes and style.aspectRatio=the desired physical face ratio. CSS applies this preferred ratio to the border box; subtracting equal 2px in each direction changes a non-square content ratio. It is a real display distortion, not Float32 geometry error.
finding.all_five_affected: The server canvases have a smaller content ratio drift and passed the old .03 absolute ratio allowance; this is not only a TOR-specific issue.

numeric_crosscheck.inference_scope: TOR content height is inferred from failure ratio and preceding desktop width, not a new browser measurement. Owner should record actual bounding/computed dimensions.

minimal_fix_recommendation.change: Add box-sizing:content-box; change width:100% to width:calc(100% - 2px); keep height:auto and existing 1px border. Explicit padding:0 makes the component contract self-contained.
minimal_fix_recommendation.reason: aspect-ratio then governs the bitmap content. Subtracting the two known 1px borders from the width preserves the current total width and avoids horizontal overflow. Keep source PNG/CanvasTexture/meta/geometry/lighting unchanged.
minimal_fix_recommendation.alternative_if_owner_prefers: border:0 plus an outline preserves content aspect without width compensation, but changes the decoration box; no need to implement both approaches.

record: computed boxSizing, border widths, padding widths, aspectRatio and transform
height residual CSSpx and chosen layout quantum
tight_actual_CSS_assertion.content_formula: contentW=rect.width-borderLeft-borderRight-paddingLeft-paddingRight; contentH=rect.height-borderTop-borderBottom-paddingTop-paddingBottom; these are direct content dimensions when no CSS transform scales the canvas. Record/assert transform none for this fixture.
tight_actual_CSS_assertion.hard_gate: Require finite positive content dimensions, then abs(contentH-contentW/expectedFaceAspect) <= 1/64 CSS px + 1e-7 numerical guard. Keep the quantum explicit for the chosen headed Chromium environment; do not use one whole CSS pixel or the old .03 ratio allowance.
tight_actual_CSS_assertion.ratio_equivalent_bound: expectedFaceAspect * quantum / contentH; checking height residual directly is clearer and scales automatically for narrow phone layouts.
tight_actual_CSS_assertion.coverage: Apply to every panel at1280/390 light/dark. Retain actual values in failure receipt before the assertion, so the offending row is not omitted.
tight_actual_CSS_assertion.Float32_boundary: Keep v3 world-coordinate Float32Array/8epsilon gates exactly as reviewed. CSS uses the configured aspect and its own layout quantization; do not reuse or enlarge the geometry tolerance.
